# Google Sheet to Mailchimp

## Purpose and structure
This folder contains the **Google Sheet to Mailchimp** workflow. Its executable nodes use `googleSheets`, `interval`, `mailchimp`, `manualTrigger`. The table and connection map below are derived from the JSON, not an inferred guarantee of behavior.

## Setup
Import inactive. Configure your own credentials and replace REPLACE_WITH_* values. Review external destinations and Code nodes before running.

## Entry points
On clicking 'execute'

## Verification
